records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.zoom_view#1
records.source: spaCR had a fit-on-load, wheel-zoom, drag-pan image canvas already: the QC field browser's own ``_FieldView``. Item 473's raw-versus-enhanced window needed the same thing twice over, and a third copy of "a QGraphicsView with a pixmap in it" is how a codebase ends up with three that behave subtly differently. So the field browser's view moved here unchanged, under a name that says it is shared, and the browser goes on using it under its old one.
records.context: spaCR had a fit-on-load, wheel-zoom, drag-pan image canvas already: the QC microscope field of view browser's own ``_FieldView``. Item 473's raw-versus-enhanced window needed the same thing twice over, and a third copy of "a QGraphicsView with a pixmap in it" is how a codebase ends up with three that behave subtly differently. So the microscope field of view browser's view moved here unchanged, under a name that says it is shared, and the browser goes on using it under its old one.
records.translation: spaCR hafði þegar myndastriga sem aðlagast við hleðslu, dregur að með hjóli og hliðrast með drætti: eigin ``_FieldView`` QC-sjónsviðsvafrans. Gluggi liðar 473 fyrir hrátt á móti bættu þurfti það sama tvisvar, og þriðja afritið af "QGraphicsView með pixmap-mynd í" er leiðin til þess að kóðasafn endi með þrjú sem hegða sér á fínlega ólíkan hátt. Svo sýn sjónsviðsvafrans var flutt hingað óbreytt, undir heiti sem segir að hún sé sameiginleg, og vafrinn heldur áfram að nota hana undir gamla heitinu.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.zoom_view#2
records.source: WHAT IS NEW HERE IS THE TIE. Two views of the same region are only worth putting side by side if they stay in register: a curator comparing a field with its enhanced self is looking for a difference between them, and a difference in where the two are pointing is the one difference that is not information. :meth:`ZoomableImageView.link_to` makes a group of views share one zoom and one scroll position, so zooming or panning any of them moves all of them.
records.context: What is new here is the tie. Two views of the same region are only worth putting side by side if they stay in register: a curator comparing a field with its enhanced self is looking for a difference between them, and a difference in where the two are pointing is the one difference that is not information. :meth:`ZoomableImageView.link_to` makes a group of views share one zoom and one scroll position, so zooming or panning any of them moves all of them.
records.translation: ÞAÐ SEM ER NÝTT HÉR ER BINDINGIN. Tvær sýnir af sama svæði eru aðeins þess virði að setja hlið við hlið ef þær haldast samstilltar: umsjónarmaður sem ber sjónsvið saman við bætta útgáfu þess leitar að mun á þeim, og munur á því hvert þær tvær vísa er eini munurinn sem er ekki upplýsingar. :meth:`ZoomableImageView.link_to` lætur hóp sýna deila einum aðdrætti og einni flettistöðu, svo aðdráttur eða hliðrun á einhverri þeirra færir þær allar.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.zoom_view#3
records.source: The tie is on the VIEW and not on the window, because what has to match is the transform and the two scroll bars -- the things a view owns. Views in a group must show images of the same size for the tie to mean anything; the compare window builds both of its pictures from one region, so they do.

records.translation: Bindingin er á SÝNINNI en ekki á glugganum, því það sem þarf að passa saman er vörpunin og flettistikurnar tvær -- það sem sýn á. Sýnir í hópi verða að sýna myndir af sömu stærð til að bindingin þýði eitthvað; samanburðarglugginn byggir báðar myndir sínar úr einu svæði, svo þær gera það.
